annotations.title: Find the email behind a LinkedIn profile

description: Given a LinkedIn profile URL, return that person's professional email address, verified live, with their current role and company. Use this when you have someone's LinkedIn page and need to email them; for a name and company without a URL use find_work_email. Spends 3 credits, refunded if no email is found.

linkedin_url.description: A LinkedIn profile URL, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/in/…

name: find_email_from_linkedin
title: Find the email behind a LinkedIn profile
